gradingPolicy.explicitDirectSuccess: Exact set of supported meaning tuples; no question or clarifications; evidence quote matches original string offsets and overlaps its fixed expected clause.
gradingPolicy.sourceEvidence: Returned evidence.quote must equal text.slice(start,end), be nonempty, and overlap the predeclared source clause for the matched meaning. Exact clause boundaries are not required.

questionPolicy.false: No question and no nonempty clarification list expected.
questionPolicy.true: A question or nonempty clarification list expected.
questionPolicy.optional: Not scored as required or unnecessary for hold-only cases.

gradingPolicy.holdSuccess: No meanings; question behavior reported separately.
gradingPolicy.wrongInference: Any returned field/value/polarity/condition tuple absent from the fixed expected set, including any meaning on hold cases.
